title: Legacy program insiders tell Corbell and Coulthart 'if you knew what I know'

tellings.quote: We hear an awful lot of unnerving stories from people like Jeremy Corbell or Ross Coloulthart who are like ostensibly talking to people on legacy programs directly and like they they all say the same thing. So they get to a certain level in the conversation, you know, whatever, and the person goes, "If you knew what I know, you wouldn't be procisure or something."

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a filmmaker, Jeremy Corbell, and a journalist, Ross Coulthart, hear unnerving stories from people they say work on "legacy programs", long-running secret government efforts said to study non-human craft. According to Michels, those insiders all say the same thing at a certain point: "If you knew what I know," you would not be pushing for disclosure. If true, it would mean insiders believe the full truth is too troubling to release.
